question.problem: A window is $1 \, \textrm{m}$ wide. What is this length in centimeters?
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the metric units of length is given below.

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kilometer | $\textrm{km}$ | $1\,\textrm{km} = 1\,000\,\textrm{m}$ |
| Meter | $\textrm{m}$ | Base Unit |
| Centimeter | $\textrm{cm}$ | $100\,\textrm{cm} = 1\,\textrm{m}$ |
| Millimeter | $\textrm{mm}$ | $1\,000\,\textrm{mm} = 1\,\textrm{m}$ |

So, $1 \, \textrm{m}$ is equivalent to $100 \, \textrm{cm}.$
